text:
All fixed and verified:

- `spiral([[1, 2, 3]])` now returns `[1, 2, 3]` (previously `[1, 2, 3, 2, 1]`)
- The 3×4 matrix now returns exactly 12 values: `[1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 12, 11, 10, 9, 5, 6, 7]`
- Single column, single element, empty matrix, and all square cases still work correctly
- All 3 existing tests pass

The root cause: in the spiral loop, when the remaining sub-matrix was a single row (`top == bottom`), the "bottom row" pass re-traversed the same row in reverse; when it was a single column (`left == right`), the "left column" pass re-traversed the same column. Guarding those two passes with `if top != bottom` and `if left != right` ensures every element is emitted exactly once.
